carpet.rule.fakePlayerPersistence.name: Fake Player Persistence
carpet.rule.fakePlayerPersistence.desc: Automatically summon recorded fake players after server restart.
carpet.rule.fakePlayerActionSaving.name: Fake Player Action Saving
carpet.rule.fakePlayerActionSaving.desc: Record fake players' ongoing actions every 30 seconds (requires Fake Player Persistence).
carpet.rule.fakePlayerPrefix.name: Fake Player Prefix
carpet.rule.fakePlayerPrefix.desc: Add a unified prefix to fake players in the tab list.
carpet.rule.entityOptimizationEnabled.de: Optimize rendering for many identical entities at the same position to improve FPS. Details in entity_optimization.json.
carpet.rule.pearlCannonEnabled.name: Pearl Cannon Encoder
carpet.rule.pearlCannonEnabled.desc: Enable /eun pearlCannon command for binary encoding calculations.
carpet.rule.globalScoreboardEnabled.name: Global Scoreboard
carpet.rule.globalScoreboardEnabled.desc: Display player statistics rankings on the scoreboard.
carpet.rule.highlightEnabled.name: Personal Highlight
carpet.rule.highlightEnabled.desc: Enable /eun highlight command to highlight items or mobs around a player.
carpet.rule.craftableInvisibleItemFrames: Craft 8 invisible item frames using 8 item frames + 1 amethyst shard.
carpet.rule.craftablePlayerHeads.name: Craftable Player Heads
carpet.rule.craftablePlayerHeads.desc: Craft player heads using a named name tag + wither skeleton skulls (1 skull = 1 head, 8 skulls = 8 heads; valid premium player name yields that player's head, otherwise a Steve head).
carpet.rule.autoTotemEquip.name: Auto Totem Equip
carpet.rule.autoTotemEquip.desc: Automatically equip a Totem of Undying from inventory/containers when about to die.
carpet.rule.suppressMagmaCubeInNetherWas: Suppress Magma Cube Spawns in Nether Wastes
Prevent magma cubes from spawning naturally in Nether Wastes (spawner spawns remain).
carpet.rule.packetEnabled.name: Fake Player Auto-Packing
carpet.rule.packetEnabled.desc: Enable /eun packet command to configure auto-packing for fake players.
carpet.rule.presetEnabled.name: Rule Preset Management
carpet.rule.presetEnabled.desc: Enable /eun preset command to batch apply, disable, or set default rule presets.
carpet.rule.sharedCommandsEnabled.name: Shared Commands
carpet.rule.sharedCommandsEnabled.desc: Enable sharing of custom commands between players. Allows uploading, editing, and deleting commands via the Command-GUI mod.
carpet.rule.sharedCommandManagePermissio: Permission level required to manage (edit/delete) other players' shared commands. 'true' = all players, 'false' = none, number = OP level (0-4).
carpet.rule.sharedCommandBlacklist.name: Shared Command Blacklist
carpet.rule.sharedCommandBlacklist.desc: Comma-separated list of command keywords that are forbidden in shared commands (e.g. 'op,ban,stop').
carpet.rule.sharedCommandMaxLength.name: Shared Command Max Length
carpet.rule.sharedCommandMaxLength.desc: Maximum allowed length (in characters) for a single command line in a shared command.
carpet.rule.preventCceShulkerOpen.name: Prevent Opening CCE Suppressor Boxes
carpet.rule.preventCceShulkerOpen.desc: Only blocks any-color shulker boxes named as CCE update suppressors; unnamed shulker boxes are unaffected. Covers placed blocks, Quick Shulker Boxes container entities, Quick Shulker inventory menus, and its bundle-style insert/extract operations. If Carpet Org Addition is installed, its CCEUpdateSuppression rule is used automatically.
carpet.rule.cceSuppressorNames.name: CCE Suppressor Names
carpet.rule.cceSuppressorNames.desc: Comma-separated fallback names used when Carpet Org Addition is not installed. When it is installed, its CCEUpdateSuppression rule takes precedence.
eun_carpet.message.cce_suppressor_open_d: You cannot open a shulker box used for update suppression
